title: Audit and secure five Admin Magazine/Loto APIs

acceptance.text: Test POST /api/admin/logout, GET /api/admin/magazine, POST /api/admin/magazine/generate, POST /api/admin/magazine/loto/autopilot, and GET /api/admin/magazine/loto/draws separately for contract, invalid/unauthorized behavior, and persistence or side effects.
All Magazine/Loto route mutations enforce admin.content.write and CSRF; reads enforce admin.content.read, with anonymous 401 and authenticated roleless 403 verified by real-router PostgreSQL tests.
Real visible Admin UI/browser validates logout, magazine list/generate, and Loto draws; autopilot is validated from same-origin visible browser session, with temporary rows cleaned.

spec.expected_behavior: Acceptance contract audited five APIs individually with fixture cleanup.
spec.observed_behavior: Five Admin Magazine/Loto APIs remain individually unverified; the route group currently applies AdminGuard but omits per-route RBAC and CSRF gates.
spec.rollback_plan: Revert only AUDIT-138-owned route/test/browser/inventory changes; retain prior audit commits.
